propositions: Packaged top-level CLI help (overview.txt) and ticket-model.md documentation retained pre-change wording stating unlink accepts no relation argument after optional relation-scoped unlink was shipped in commit 73abb5805f.

The unlink operation now accepts an optional relation selector as a third argument to remove exactly that relation or fall back to most-recent when omitted, but two maintained documentation surfaces did not reflect this change.
Event schema documentation must distinguish the optional relation selector from the emitted link-UUID targeted UNLINK event cancellation.
Documentation contract tests prove the contradiction between real CLI behavior (advertises [relation]) and published help/model prose (omits relation argument).
